description: PHP class defining a client to interact with Amazon Lex Runtime V2 service with method signatures for session management, text recognition, and utterance recognition.

classes.name: Aws	he\LexRuntimeV2\LexRuntimeV2Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Lex Runtime V2.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session in Amazon Lex.

methods.name: deleteSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session in Amazon Lex.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves session information from Amazon Lex.

methods.name: putSession
methods.description: Creates or updates a session in Amazon Lex.

methods.name: putSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a session.

methods.name: recognizeText
methods.description: Recognizes text input with Amazon Lex.

methods.name: recognizeUtterance
methods.description: Recognizes user utterance for Amazon Lex.
